about: Manual verdicts on every disagreement between the AST localizer and the line-attribution cross-check, and on a random audit sample. Reviewed by Claude (claude-opus-5-5) on 2026-10-12 by reading each patch against the buggy file.

disagreements.cause: Only a comment changes inside the function (siderial -> sidereal).
New functions with multi-line signatures are added below the method. The closing `) -> ...:` line ends the cross-check's new-definition tracking, so it credits the new bodies to the method above.
Same multi-line signature defect as pylint-dev__pylint-4551, for the new function `_is_ignored_file`.
A `raise` statement is re-indented from 16 to 12 spaces; the block structure, and so the syntax tree, is identical.
Only `# TODO` comment lines are added inside the methods.
The repair adds `__add__` and `__radd__` to the `__proxy__` class defined inside `lazy`. The cross-check skips new definitions; the localizer sees that `lazy`'s syntax tree changed.
Only comment lines are added inside the method.

audit.method: 25 supported instances drawn with random.Random(20261012).sample from the 192 scored supported instances. Each target was checked against the patch hunks and, where a hunk header named a different function, against the buggy file's function line spans.
notes: astropy__astropy-14508 and pytest-dev__pytest-7490: the hunk header names a different function from the one changed; the localizer names the changed one.
sphinx-doc__sphinx-8475 and astropy__astropy-7336: a change inside a nested function is credited to the enclosing function.
pytest-dev__pytest-5262 and scikit-learn__scikit-learn-14629: the repair only adds a method, so the target is the class.
Import-only and module-level changes (for example astropy__astropy-14369's parser table) are left out when a function changes.
